subject.title: Add config flag to always show provider in model picker (not only on name collisions)

question: Should provider visibility in model pickers be solved by a new opt-in config flag, by changing the default picker display policy, or by folding it into broader model-picker grouping/runtime-label work?
rationale: The current behavior is real in Control UI, but OpenClaw policy sets a high bar for new config surface and adjacent open picker work already explores route/runtime visibility, so automation should not choose the permanent UX contract.

options.title: Pick one canonical picker policy first
options.body: Decide the default or hybrid display rule for multi-provider catalogs before adding configuration, so Control UI and TUI do not drift into separate label schemes.

options.title: Add the requested opt-in config
options.body: Accept the extra config surface and require one documented schema path with focused regression tests for Control UI and any TUI picker that uses friendly labels.

options.title: Fold into adjacent picker UX work
options.body: Route this into the runtime/grouping label cluster so maintainers can avoid parallel provider, runtime, and auth-route labels.

recommendation.title: Pick one canonical picker policy first
recommendation.body: Decide the default or hybrid display rule for multi-provider catalogs before adding configuration, so Control UI and TUI do not drift into separate label schemes.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed/merged the current Control UI picker behavior and are listed for CLI ownership, which best matches the cross-surface product decision.
